title: Answer First, Reason Later: Commitment Order in Diffusion LLMs
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05687v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can commit tokens in any order -- a freedom marketed as their core advantage over autoregressive decoding. We show that on reasoning tasks this freedom is instead the axis of failure. Logging every commitment during decoding of LLaDA-8B on GSM8K, we find that unconstrained (pure) decoding commits the final answer at 15-24% of the trajectory while half the reasoning region is still masked, and collapses to answer-only outputs on up to 90% of problems as the canvas grows. The cause is not the model's termination beliefs -- EOS "pressure" is nearly identical across decoders -- but reachability: whether the sampler may act on those beliefs at distant positions. reason_zh: 揭示扩散LLM在推理任务上因自由提交顺序而失败，提出承诺顺序约束，具有反直觉洞察。
summary_zh: 本文研究了掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）在推理任务上的解码行为。与自回归模型不同，dLLM可以任意顺序提交token，这被视为其优势。然而，作者通过记录LLaDA-8B在GSM8K上的解码过程发现，无约束的纯解码会过早提交最终答案，导致推理失败。为此，他们提出了一种承诺顺序约束方法，引导模型先推理后提交答案，显著提升了推理准确率。这一发现挑战了dLLM自由顺序的固有优势，为扩散模型在推理任务上的应用提供了重要指导。
title_zh: 先答后思：扩散LLM中的承诺顺序

title: MACRO: Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05872v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) execute layers sequentially. Dynamic layer routing, i.e. search for a different execution path through layers involving layer repetitions, skips and other moves, can improve performance. Existing routing approaches often require updating model weights, running expensive search loops per test instance, or demand ground-truth labels during inference. In this work, we propose Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers (MACRO), a framework that learns task-specific routes over LLM architectures without modifying underlying parameters. MACRO models layer routing as a context-dependent Markov policy conditioned on layer indices, computation budget phases, directional displacements, and operator context, supporting skip, repeat, and residual hidden-state addition operations. The Markov route distribution is updated via feedback on training data and decoded using a top-k Viterbi algorithm to isolate high-pro
reason_zh: 提出马尔可夫链路由Transformer层，无需权重更新即可动态选择执行路径，创新性强。
summary_zh: 标准大语言模型按顺序执行所有层。本文提出动态层路由，即通过层重复、跳过等操作搜索不同执行路径，以提升性能。现有方法需要更新模型权重或进行昂贵的搜索。作者提出MACRO，利用马尔可夫链对层间转移进行建模，实现无需权重更新的高效路由。实验显示MACRO在多个任务上提升性能，同时保持推理效率。
title_zh: MACRO：Transformer层的马尔可夫链路由

title: GROM: Gradient-Free Rapid One-Shot Machine Unlearning
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05783v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Machine unlearning has become a critical capability for safely removing specific, sensitive knowledge from large language models (LLMs). Current state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on iterative, training-time unlearning via fine-tuning. However, even when utilizing parameter-efficient dimensionality reduction techniques like LoRA, gradient-based optimization remains computationally expensive and lacks explicit analytical formulations. It can also leave the targeted knowledge merely hidden rather than removed, to the point that simply quantizing the unlearned model restores much of what it was supposed to have erased. To resolve this, we propose a novel one-shot unlearning approach, abandoning iterative optimization in favor of a direct, exact analytical solution. reason_zh: 提出GROM，无需梯度的快速一次性机器遗忘方法，高效移除LLM敏感知识，实用性强。
summary_zh: GROM是一种无需梯度的快速一次性机器遗忘方法，用于从大型语言模型中移除特定敏感知识。现有方法主要依赖迭代微调，计算成本高。GROM通过一次性操作，无需梯度计算即可实现遗忘，显著提高效率。实验表明，GROM在保持模型整体性能的同时，有效移除目标知识，为LLM的安全合规提供了高效解决方案。
title_zh: GROM：无需梯度的快速一次性机器遗忘

title: Decomposed Entailment for Factuality Checking and Hallucination Detection
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05823v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is often compromised by factual inconsistencies, including hallucinations---cases where generated content is not supported by the underlying source. We present HallDetect, a lightweight, reference-free, and black-box framework for hallucination detection that we evaluate not only on summarization but across a broader range of source-grounded generation settings. HallDetect builds on decomposition-based factuality evaluation: generated content is decomposed into atomic claims, each verified by a compact encoder-based entailment model through a contrastive formulation over a multi-scale library of source chunks, and aggregated with an asymmetric score in which a single confidently contradicted claim flags the response. Under a controlled protocol in which all methods share the same 4-bit quantized backbones and consumer-grade hardware budget, HallDetect outperforms comparably resourced genera
reason_zh: 提出轻量级幻觉检测框架，无需参考和黑盒访问，实用性强，对提升LLM可靠性有直接帮助。
summary_zh: 本文提出HallDetect，一个轻量级、无需参考、黑盒的幻觉检测框架，用于检测大语言模型生成内容与源文档的不一致。作者将事实核查分解为细粒度的蕴含判断，并在摘要任务上评估。HallDetect不依赖模型内部状态，仅通过输出文本进行判断，具有较好的泛化能力。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上优于现有基线，为幻觉检测提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Causal Episodic Memory for Feedback-Driven Agent Repair
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05906v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents that repair failures often discard successful corrections, forcing later episodes to rediscover similar solutions. We study whether finalized repair outcomes can improve subsequent Text-to-SQL episodes without parameter updates. We introduce MERIT, a training-free agent that maintains an online dual-polarity memory of oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions. Under oracle-assisted benchmark feedback, only memories from earlier finalized episodes are eligible for retrieval. A deterministic classifier assigns a coarse failure type, which conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever before the frozen model generates each revision. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with identical initial predictions and repair budgets, MERIT improves execution accuracy over stateless iterative repair from \(66.34\%\) to \(69.79\%\) on Spider and from \(47.35\%\) to \(48.44\%\) on BIRD. Paired analyses provide clear evidence for the
reason_zh: 提出训练免费的记忆机制，让Agent复用修复经验，提升Text-to-SQL任务效率，实用性强。
summary_zh: 本文研究LLM代理在修复失败时往往丢弃成功修正的问题，导致后续重复发现类似解决方案。作者提出MERIT，一个无需训练的代理，维护在线双极性记忆，存储经Oracle验证的修正。在Text-to-SQL任务中，MERIT利用记忆避免重复错误，提升后续情节的成功率，且无需参数更新。实验证明该方法有效。

title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05660v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintroducing shortcut-prone information. We identify this trade-off and propose a three-stream detector that combines motion with two restricted views of location. A coarse region reader based on vector quantization and a fine direction reader over normalized multi-layer states. reason_zh: 揭示LLM推理错误在残差流轨迹中的区域和方向，提供可解释性新视角，对模型调试有重要价值。
summary_zh: 该论文研究大型语言模型在推理过程中的错误模式，发现推理错误在残差流轨迹中具有特定的区域和方向。通过分析层间残差流位移，作者识别出错误推理与正确推理在表示空间中的差异，并利用这些信号来区分可靠与有缺陷的推理。实验表明，该方法能有效检测推理错误，为理解LLM内部机制和提升推理可靠性提供了新工具。

title: Cross-Architecture Steering Transfer in Language Models: A Systematic Empirical Study
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05164v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Independently trained large language models may develop shared internal representations of semantic concepts despite architectural differences -- but whether this geometric similarity has functional consequences for cross-model behavioural control remains untested. We present the first systematic evaluation of cross-model steering transfer and show that shared LLM geometry is functionally exploitable, conditionally: concept directions from one model can steer a different independently trained model when sufficient representational capacity exists. We study five open-weight models spanning three parameter scales (0.8B--8B) and two architectural lineages, training one Sparse Autoencoder per model across 15 semantic domains and testing alignment across all 20 directed model pairs. We observe a suggestive discontinuity near 1.7B parameters: at >= 1.7B scale, 47--49% of cross-model feature pairs validate (Pearson r >= 0.60, Procrustes cosines
reason_zh: 首次系统研究跨架构steering迁移，证明独立训练模型共享语义表征的功能性后果，对模型可解释性和控制有深远意义。
summary_zh: 本文首次系统评估跨模型steering迁移。独立训练的大型语言模型可能发展出共享的语义概念内部表征，尽管架构不同，但这种几何相似性是否对跨模型行为控制有功能性后果尚未测试。作者通过实验证明，跨模型steering迁移是可行的，表明共享表征具有功能意义。这一发现对理解模型内部机制和开发跨模型控制方法有重要价值。
title_zh: 语言模型中跨架构Steering迁移：系统性实证研究

title: Position: It's Time to Optimize LLMs for Self-Consistency
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05188v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Despite ever-increasing sophistication in language model (LM) pre- and post-training pipelines, many important failures persist: models overcondition on user framing ("sycophancy"), exhibit incomplete logical generalization, and produce confident but incorrect responses. We argue that these failures arise from a modeling assumption permeating all aspects of the pipeline: that behavior can be specified and evaluated independently on single-output pairs. Many model failures are difficult, if not impossible, to detect without reasoning about relationships between a model's responses across inputs. In this position paper, we propose self-consistency as a framework for understanding these failures. summary_zh: 本文提出观点：是时候优化LLM的自一致性了。尽管预训练和后训练流程日益复杂，但模型仍存在许多重要失败：过度依赖用户框架（谄媚）、逻辑泛化不完整、产生自信但错误的响应。作者认为这些失败源于贯穿所有方面的建模假设。他们主张将自一致性作为优化目标，以提升模型的可靠性和鲁棒性。

title: FormBharo: Designing and Evaluating a Voice Agent for Conversational Form Filling in Rural India
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.06027v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In India, almost every social benefit starts with a form, yet the people who need these benefits most are often unable to read or write. Reaching them requires a spoken conversation. Today that work falls to frontline health workers who enroll beneficiaries one at a time, a poor use of stretched capacity. We built FormBharo ("fill the form" in Hindi), a voice agent that fills a structured form over a phone call under tight latency and cost budgets by pairing Large Language Models (LLMs) with deterministic, rule-based validation and flow control. It is being piloted with ARMMAN, an NGO running large-scale maternal and child mobile-health programs in India, to enroll low-income, Hindi-speaking mothers in antenatal and postnatal care. To our knowledge, it is the first voice agent piloted to fill an enrollment form for this population. We openly release FormVoiceAgentBench, a benchmark pairing human-recorded Hindi audio with 3,760 multi-turn
reason_zh: 面向印度农村的语音表单填写代理，解决文盲人群的福利申请难题，社会价值高。

title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05850v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling. Existing multilingual corpora and benchmarks are often poor proxies for the language, containing substantial amounts of noisy, machine-translated, and misclassified text. We address these gaps by introducing Oytser, a high-quality Yiddish pretraining corpus that combines contemporary web-native sources with literary materials, and Kashes, a multi-task benchmark spanning translation, linguistic analysis, information extraction, and language understanding. Using these resources, we continue pretraining Llama 3.1 8B to obtain MameLoshnLM. Across the tasks in the benchmark, MameLoshnLM outperforms open baselines of similar scale. Our analyses show that these gains

title: 专为 AI 智能体打造的云端浏览器，Cloudflare 发布 Kitesurf
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 8 日消息，Cloudflare 前天宣布推出 Kitesurf，这是一款专为 AI 智能体打造的云端浏览器。

IT之家了解到，AI 使用浏览器的方式与人类有所不同，AI 并不关注标签页和 UI 等视觉元素，而是重点管理上下文窗口、性能表现和可扩展性，同时还要防范提示词注入等攻击风险。

Kitesurf 浏览器运行在 Cloudflare Workers 服务平台之上，它可以浏览网站、填写表单，开发者可以通过代码控制，并通过 Cloudflare 的平台与无头浏览器实例交互。

此外，Kitesurf 相比 Chromium 消耗的计算资源更少，可显著降低运行成本，让 AI 智能体更高效地上网。该浏览器目前处于测试阶段，正式版将在未来推出。

summary_zh: Cloudflare推出Kitesurf，一款专为AI智能体打造的云端浏览器。与传统浏览器不同，Kitesurf关注上下文窗口、性能和可扩展性，并防范提示词注入等攻击。该产品旨在为AI代理提供更安全高效的浏览环境。

title: AMD 收购将权重直接刻在芯片上的 AI 初创公司
raw_text: AMD 收购了将权重直接刻在芯片上的 AI 初创公司 Taalas。Taalas 创办于 2023 年，它研发专门用于执行 AI 模型推理任务的集成电路 MSIC（代表 model-specific integrated circuits），其推理速度比 GPU 和其它专用加速器高出一个数量级以上。Taalas 今年 2 月展示了它用台积电 6nm 工艺制造的测试芯片 HC1，测试显示芯片能以每秒 16,960 个 tokens 的速度处理 Meta 的 Llama 3.1 8B 模型，这一速度比英伟达的 GPU 快 48 倍，比 Cerebras 的加速器快 8.5 倍。Taalas 计划今夏推出第二代 HC2 芯片，目标是将参数数量提升至 200 亿。它的缺点是一旦部署只能使用当前的模型，新模型需要重新设计芯片，但并不需要从零开始设计，只需要更换两层金属，因此既便宜也省时间。
reason_zh: AMD收购芯片初创Taalas，其技术将权重刻入芯片，推理速度远超GPU，值得关注。
summary_zh: AMD收购了AI初创公司Taalas，该公司开发将模型权重直接刻在芯片上的集成电路（MSIC），推理速度比GPU快一个数量级以上。其测试芯片HC1基于台积电6nm工艺，处理Llama 3.1 8B模型速度达每秒16,960 tokens，比英伟达GPU快48倍。第二代HC2计划将参数提升至200亿。缺点是模型固定，但更换金属层即可适配新模型，成本低。
title_zh: AMD收购将权重直接刻在芯片上的AI初创公司
